snapshot.title: Add rocket purchase confirmation and balance updates
snapshot.description: Require purchase confirmation before creating rockets in earth_launchpad.tscn; track user francs balance (start 10B, rockets cost 1B, refund on self-destruct).

acceptanceCriteria.text: User must confirm purchase before rocket is created
Creating a rocket deducts 1B francs from balance
Self-destructing a rocket refunds 1B francs
User starts with 10B francs

changes.newValue:
1. Inspect launchpad rocket creation and self-destruct flows; identify balance source and UI touchpoints.
2. Add purchase confirmation + balance check/deduct on rocket creation (click + drag) and return success from spawn.
3. Refund balance on self-destruct; keep AppController balance in sync; update defaults to 10B.
4. Sanity check behavior in launchpad and new mission panel (no tests run unless requested).
